newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kuehne & Nagel views China joint ventures.
newsitem.headline: Kuehne & Nagel views China joint ventures.

text.p: International freight forwarder Kuehne & Nagel AG said it is examining setting up joint ventures in the fast-growing Chinese market.

Chief executive officer Klaus-Michael Kuehne said in a speech to 200 employees of parent company Viag AG that the Chinese transport market was becoming more important internationally and in inner-Asia trade.
He said in Asian container transport alone, China represented a market worth more than 10 million TEU (20-foot containers), according to a company statement.
Kuehne & Nagel would increase its China stations from nine to 20 by 2000, and expand from sea and air freight forwarding into logistics and warehousing, Kuehne said.
"To speed up these activities we are also looking into the possibility of founding joint ventures and strategic alliances with local partners," he added.
Kuehne & Nagel would also expand beyond India and Sri Lanka to Pakistan and Bangladesh, he said.

"India is a sleeping giant which has very slowly woken since 1991. Its economy has enormous development potential which will not lag behind China in the medium-term," he said. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax +44 171 542 5017
